output.brief: The August drop is mainly a cooling failure on floors 6-8. Chiller CH-2 failed 4-19 August, and floors 6-8 ran at 26.5-29 C against a 22 C set point. Scores on those floors fell to 6.8 during the outage and recovered to 8.4 afterwards. Heat was named in 56 complaints, all from floors 6-8. Floors 1-5 stayed steady. Cleanliness, check-in, and housekeeping inspection pass rates did not move, so the contractor and kiosks look unlikely causes. The 6% rate rise did not change the overall score on floors 1-5. The value-score dip also appears every August, so it is not clearly caused by the rate rise. I am fairly confident in the cooling cause. The survey method was unchanged, so the drop is probably real. Next: reinstate the deferred maintenance on both chillers, keep critical spare parts on site, and write a guest-recovery plan for future outages. Do not serve notice on Orrin or drop the August floor 6-8 responses on the current evidence. Revisit the kiosks and rates only if new data points to them.
